ideas.pitch: A hyper-local municipal waste management and automated route optimization platform tailored for smart cities like Rourkela.
ideas.title: OdishaSmartWaste
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the proven trash and waste management hackathon-winning pattern by addressing a concrete municipal pain point with a working dashboard.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent sustainability and student green-campus support system built for campus-level carbon footprint reduction tracking.
ideas.title: EcoRourkela AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines multi-agent student support frameworks with clear measurable environmental impact, matching successful green-tech hackathon templates.

ideas.pitch: A GPS-enabled walk-to-earn community engagement and local artisan discovery platform featuring a live civic impact dashboard.
ideas.title: LocalPulse Odisha
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates a proven civic tech real-world impact architecture that won major hackathons by combining consumer incentives with municipal analytics.

ideas.pitch: A voice-first agentic web interface designed to detect and protect vulnerable users from localized financial and digital scams in regional dialects.
ideas.title: FraudShield Voice
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features hard engineering around voice-first agentic workflows and solves an urgent, highly relatable cyber-fraud problem.

ideas.pitch: An automated satellite and industrial monitoring dashboard for tracking environmental zoning compliance and land usage changes.
ideas.title: ComplianceScan AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies heavy geospatial data processing and computer vision concepts into an easily digestible web dashboard that appeals directly to judges.
